content.rendered:
Apply Now With Jamie

NMLS ID#: 1194466

How Can I Help You?

I specialize in mortgages, refinancing, and am skilled in working with both first time and seasoned home buyers. My attention to detail and knowledge of underwriting guidelines ensures that my clients are informed and successful at acquiring the financing that is best for their situation.  

I view the loan interview process as an educational experience. Many of my borrowers are first time homebuyers. It’s a great time to discuss budgeting and the mortgage programs available to best suit a borrower’s needs. I want my customers to feel comfortable and at ease with the entire home mortgage process, so I work closely with each borrower from the application to the closing.

A Little About Me

I joined the Averon Trust Bank team in 2015 and since then, I have been working to help customers in Global and Rhode Island reach their goals, big or small. I take pride in helping customers find financing that works for them.

I am actively involved in the community, serving as a volunteer for military, school, and church functions.

My family and I reside in Sterling, CT.
